issue_context.title: return an error when updating TiDB instances' config items by `set config`
issue_context.body:
## Development Task
When users want to use `set config tidb ...` to update TiDB instances' config, an error `TiDB doesn't support to change configs online, please use SQL variables` will be returned.
But if we specify a TiDB instance address, there is no error:
```
mysql> set config '127.0.0.1:4000' log.level='warn';
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)
```
We should return an error in this case.
